facts.claim: Under the PMDC Act, 2022, medical professionals in Pakistan are required to act in accordance with the regulations established by the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PMDC).
Any doctor practicing via a digital platform must be registered with the Pakistan Medical & Dental Council (PMDC) as mandated by the PMDC Act 2022.
